svg.text: Phone 375
The line drops the figure on a phone
Notes
The row reuses needs-you.tsx as is: a new invoice kind, lucide Receipt, the word Review. It opens /invoices?view=review.
Detail: the senders, oldest invoice first, each name once. Two names, then "and N more"; an unmatched sender counts in the more.
The sample is screen 1's To review: Dave Kim, Zack Reading, and a billing@ address flagged "Who's this from?".
One reads "1 invoice to review". With To review empty the row goes, and "4 need you" drops to 3.
No amount and no date: an emailed invoice has no total until someone types it, so a sum would read low.
Laptop and tablet use the wide row (list 480px or more). Tablet is touch: 48px rows, 16px marks, 20px chevron.
Phone: the word leads the subline; at 375 it cuts near "and 1 more", at 320 inside the second name. The title holds the count.
At 320 the title fits on one line and nothing new drops; the fourth row on waits behind "1 more", as today.
Order (Connor's call): key dates and lease ends, stuck draws, invoices, sign-ups, Baselane, Missing info, CapEx, QuickBooks.
Snooze line: To review view only, under the switch; a phone says "On your Home". Header and list there are screen 1's.
Recommended: a new invoice ends a snooze, so money owed can't hide for a month. D3 as written keeps it hidden.
Both partners see the row; a snooze is only yours (D4). One Esc closes the Snooze menu and leaves the line.
